summary: 1939 CCC-era 100-ft steel tower on a ridge near Nelsonville, OH; top and cab moved to Hocking College; rebuilt at Wayne NF HQ in 2007, where it now stores radio gear.

facts.status_note: The ridgetop tower is gone (FFLA list: Tower Gone). The tower was rebuilt at the Wayne National Forest headquarters on US 33, where it stands.

access.note: Forest Service says the rebuilt tower is not open to the public; an undated third-party guide says it is open for limited public use. No source describes the ridgetop site today.

visit.trail_note: Marker and rebuilt tower are on the Wayne NF headquarters grounds on US 33. No source says whether the tower itself may be entered.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wayne National Forest

events.note: Built with CCC labor. The register says the 1930s; the marker, the Forest Lookouts page and the Flickr caption say 1939.
Register date: the top 20 feet and the 7-by-7 cab went to Hocking College. Other sources date the dismantling to the 1970s.
Approximate. Sources say only the 1970s for the dismantling of the tower.
Not used regularly since 1972, when the Forest Service began aerial surveillance (1975 Logan Daily News item quoted by Forest Lookouts).
Forest Service reacquired the tower and rebuilt it at the Wayne National Forest headquarters, restoring the full 100 feet.
Registered May 18, 2010 as US 879, OH 8 (the rebuilt tower's register entry).
FFLA Ohio chapter report: the tower had been relocated and opened next to the headquarters, and was certified by the association.

corrections.why: The NHLR entry we read sits at the single-path address; the doubled nhlr.org/nhlr.org path does not match the register's page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the top section's move to Hocking College to 1964. Natural Ohio and the Forest Service caption say the tower was dismantled in the 1970s. The story gives both dates and does not choose between them.

The Forest Service caption says the tower is not open to the public. An undated Natural Ohio guide says it is open for limited public use. The story leads with the Forest Service's statement and reports the guide's statement as undated.

notes_for_editor: Original ridgetop site: no source describes what remains there. County is in dispute (marker says Athens; Forest Lookouts and FFLA list say Hocking; FFLA lists the rebuilt tower in Athens). Build date is 1939 in most sources, 1930s in the register. The rebuilt tower is covered by us-oh-snake-ridge-at-wayne-nf-headquarters. No new photos added: the Flickr page gives no direct image URL we could verify.
